Chat folders
Need to keep track of your chats?
Enabling chat folders organizes your chats for easy access in
the Chats tab.
This separates one-to-one conversations, groups, official
accounts, and OpenChats so you never miss another message.
Send feedback
See example v
Open links in your default browser ®
Always open links in your default browser instead of LINE's in-
app browser. You'll no longer need to copy links or use the
"Open in your default browser" option from the Share menu.
Send feedback
Search for media in chat
Search for images, videos, audio, or text appearing in media
content in the chat.
We will never collect this content or send it to third parties.
Only content sent or received after you enable this feature will
be searchable.
This feature uses functions introduced in iOS 15 and iPadOS
15.
Please note that different versions of iOS or iPadOS support
different languages when searching for text inside media
content.
